def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    MOD = 1000000007

    def mod_pow(base, e):
        result = 1
        while e > 0:
            if e & 1:
                result = (result * base) % MOD
            base = (base * base) % MOD
            e >>= 1
        return result

    def find_par(x, par):
        if par[x] == x:
            return x
        par[x] = find_par(par[x], par)
        return par[x]

    def unite(a, b, par):
        a = find_par(a, par)
        b = find_par(b, par)
        if a == b:
            return False
        par[b] = a
        return True

    if k == 0:
        print(mod_pow(p, p - 1))
        return

    par = list(range(p))
    comp_count = p - (1 if k > 1 else 0)

    for i in range(1, p):
        unite(i, (i * k) % p, par)

    print(mod_pow(p, comp_count))
